name: jk-1166-entertainment-mode-refactor
goal: Each first-floor room reacts to entertainment mode itself, the mode survives a restart, and phase 2 plays music in a chosen zone.

userStories.title: Restart-safe boolean and house-level pieces
userStories.description: Drop initial from entertainment_mode, delete the two central automations, add house-empty off (with for), bedtime off, master speech pause/resume.
acceptanceCriteria: input_boolean.entertainment_mode has no initial
entertainment_mode_activated and _deactivated files are gone
house-empty off triggers on house_occupied off for 2 minutes and turns the boolean off only when it is on
bedtime off turns the boolean off; speech pause/resume turn input_boolean.speech_notifications off/on on the boolean edges
no entertainment file uses automation.turn_on/off or initial_state

userStories.title: Per-room on/off pairs
userStories.description: Kitchen, family room, playroom, foyer, office, main bedroom each get <room>_entertainment_mode_on/_off in packages/<room>/modes/.
acceptanceCriteria: on files turn the room's AL switch off (and kitchen/family room speech boolean off)
off files turn the AL switch on; kitchen and family room speech back on only if occupied and in the same modes as the room's speech_on automation
dining room has no file
filename equals id; header comment; modern syntax; conditions global to feature

userStories.title: Gate the automations that fight the mode
userStories.description: Add entertainment_mode off as the first condition on kitchen/family_room/playroom music off, family_room_tv_off, playroom_media_player_unjoin, kitchen/family_room speech_notifications_on, house_mode_speech_on.
acceptanceCriteria: each of the 8 has the condition first in conditions
TV never turned on by the mode

userStories.title: Phase 1 tests and docs
userStories.description: tests/test_entertainment_mode.py; update test_office_call_lighting and test_restart_restore_regressions; README, LEARNINGS, AUTOMATIONS.md.
acceptanceCriteria: new tests pass and each sabotage in the plan goes red
existing tests updated, KNOWN_REMAINING drops entertainment_mode_deactivated, HELPERS has the boolean
full suite green

userStories.title: Music helpers and zone config
userStories.description: input_select zone, input_text favourite, template select playlist, input_number volume, started flag, sensor.entertainment_zone_config (indoor via sonos_living_room as dining, outdoor).
acceptanceCriteria: no helper has initial
indoor speakers are kitchen, family_room, living_room, playroom; coordinator kitchen
outdoor speakers are patio, pool, gazebo; coordinator patio
no TV entity in any list

userStories.title: Music start, stop and zone-change automations
userStories.description: Start on mode on with guards, stop on mode off when started flag set, move on zone change.
acceptanceCriteria: start guards: house_occupied, bedtime off, no emergency, crazy phase Off, zone not Off, favourite in source_list
volume set from helper/100 on speakers; every zone speaker joins, including the family room Sonos (the TV is a separate device)
stop only when flag on; clears flag
zone change only while mode and flag on

userStories.title: Crazy Mode mutual exclusion
userStories.description: Add an entertainment reason to sensor.crazy_mode_reason.
acceptanceCriteria: reason is entertainment when the mode is on (after emergency, before house_mode)
start refusal is silent for it
existing crazy tests stay green

userStories.title: Dashboard popup controls
userStories.description: House mode popup gets zone, playlist and volume next to the Entertainment toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: only existing and new helper entities are referenced
dashboard tests green

userStories.title: Phase 2 tests and docs
userStories.description: Tests for zone config, start/stop, crazy reason, helpers; README/LEARNINGS.
acceptanceCriteria: sabotage: drop crazy guard, drop started-flag condition on stop
full suite green
